items.headline: AI funding fears rattle Wall Street and raise concerns about Meta’s future financing needs
items.summary: CNBC’s Investing Club discussed how concerns about debt-funded AI spending weighed on AI stocks and overshadowed Meta’s strong earnings. The report highlighted Meta’s disclosure that its long-term plans could require hundreds of billions of dollars in additional financing and its plan to create a non-voting Class C stock to help fund investments and acquisitions without diluting Mark Zuckerberg’s voting control.
